skills.summary: Review last month against your budget
skills.job: Compare last month's actual spending with the user's budget, explain the gaps and set one or two adjustments for next month.
triggers: did I stick to my budget
gotchas: Judging a one-off bill as a habit
Moving the budget after the fact to fit the spending
Ignoring irregular costs that land in one month

skills.summary: Compare payoff orders for your debts
skills.job: Lay out payoff timelines for the user's debts under a chosen order and extra payment, using the balances and rates the user supplies.
triggers: plan how to pay off my debts
how long to clear my cards
gotchas: Ignoring minimum payments on the other debts
Using a rate that differs from the statement
Assuming no new spending on the cards

skills.summary: Turn a savings goal into monthly steps
skills.job: Work out how much to set aside each period to reach a savings goal by a date, with a check on whether it fits the budget.
triggers: how much should I save each month
plan to save for a goal
gotchas: Assuming interest the user has not confirmed
Setting an amount the budget cannot hold
Forgetting that prices of the goal can change

skills.job: Find recurring charges in a statement export, list them with cost per year and last use, and mark ones to review.
triggers: what subscriptions am I paying for
gotchas: Missing annual charges that appear once
Flagging a shared plan as unused
Cancelling before checking notice terms

skills.summary: Set up a simple way to track spending
skills.job: Design a spending tracker for the user's habits with categories, a capture routine and a weekly check, in the tool they already use.
triggers: help me start tracking my spending
how do I track what I spend
gotchas: Too many categories to keep up
A routine that needs daily effort
Choosing a tool the user will not open

skills.summary: Size and build a cash buffer
skills.job: Help the user work out a buffer target from their own essential costs and plan how to build it in steps.
triggers: how big should my emergency fund be
gotchas: Counting non-essential spending in the target
Presenting one fixed number of months as a rule
Mixing the buffer with money meant for other goals

skills.job: Lay out the full cost, the trade-offs and the questions to answer before a large personal purchase, without telling the user to buy or not.
gotchas: Looking only at the monthly payment
Leaving out running and upkeep costs
Deciding under time pressure from the seller

skills.summary: List what you own and owe
skills.job: Build a dated snapshot of assets and debts from the user's balances and compute net worth, with notes on how each value was found.
gotchas: Valuing items at the price paid
Mixing dates between accounts
Counting money that is owed to others as the user's own

skills.summary: Map bills onto a pay-period calendar
skills.job: Build a calendar of due dates against pay dates so the user sees tight weeks and can adjust timing.
gotchas: Missing annual and quarterly bills
Ignoring weekends and processing delays
Putting every bill in the first week

skills.job: Analyse a transaction export for trends, repeat merchants and unusual items, and report what the data shows without judging choices.
gotchas: Treating transfers as spending
Comparing months of different length
Judging choices instead of describing them

skills.summary: Track side income and its costs
skills.job: Set up a record of side income and related costs by period, with a clear split from personal money.
gotchas: Mixing business and personal spending
Not recording income when it is received
Assuming tax treatment without checking

skills.summary: Reflect on money habits and set small goals
skills.job: Guide a short reflection on the user's money habits and turn it into one or two small, measurable habit changes.
triggers: I want to be better with money
gotchas: Shaming the user for past choices
Setting too many changes at once
Giving fixed rules in place of the user's own priorities

skills.summary: Organise receipts and records for later
skills.job: Set up a folder and naming scheme for receipts and sort an existing pile of files into it without deleting anything.
gotchas: Deleting originals
Names that sort in the wrong order
Missing a retention period the user must check
